title: Persist finished tasks as durable graph memory with team visibility
context: Hunch captures decisions and findings as durable, team-shareable graph records. Tasks previously lived only in local ephemeral ledger, preventing lesson reuse and team visibility across sessions/machines. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_91e6074b66 (Capability pages for functionality shipped in the current release must state that it ships today and must not retain the stale banner 'In development for the next release.'); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Finished tasks with observations are now persisted to `.hunch/tasks/<id>.json` through the existing capture path (same public/private homing, one-home rule, auto-commit, team routing as decisions/findings). Bounded summary kept: delivered lesson revisions, agent-reported applications, saves with durability, observed checks, touched files, content hash. Empty tasks stay ledger-only. Sensitive data (prompt, transcript, denial reasons) never leave ledger.
consequences: Tasks become searchable via full-text index and `hunch_why <file>` queries
Finished tasks on one machine/teammate visible to others with proper access controls (public/private homing)
`hunch report <id>` retrieves tasks from graph after local ledger is cleared
VS Code Contribution view and `hunch task list` show both local observations and graph records
Default enabled; opt-out via `"taskRecords": false` in `.hunch/local.json`
alternatives_rejected: Keep tasks ephemeral in ledger only (no persistence, no team visibility)
Persist all tasks including empty ones (chosen: only tasks with observations, bounded summaries)
Create separate capture path for tasks instead of reusing decision/finding infrastructure
